# Version 4.150.2
> **GPU correctness fixes** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 brings m150 fixes for Ganesh GPU rendering and SkSL raster-pipeline code generation. It prevents stale texture readbacks after failed flushes, restores dirty tracking when resolve tasks fail, and corrects framebuffer cleanup on Imagination GPUs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m150 servicing fixes rolled forward** — Includes four upstream syncs covering SkSL raster-pipeline lifetime safety, failed Ganesh flush and resolve handling, stale readbacks, and Imagination GPU framebuffer deletion. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663), [#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561), [#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517))

Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2 with this SkiaSharp servicing release.
